# thunder_scaleout_user_group_assignment_template (Resource)

`thunder_scaleout_user_group_assignment_template`: Configure scaleout user group assignment templates

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Scaleout User Group Assignment Template Name

### Optional

- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object
- `v4_assignment_list` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--v4_assignment_list))
- `v6_assignment_list` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--v6_assignment_list))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--v4_assignment_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `v4_assignment_list`

Required:

- `ipv4_prefix` (String) IPv4 prefix

Optional:

- `assignment_prefix_auto` (Number) Automatically break down the prefix so that each user-group is assigned one and only one subnet
- `assignment_prefix_length` (Number) User group assignment prefix length, default is 32
- `private_ip` (Number) Set the assignment as private, and no BGP route will be advertised for it
- `service_config_template` (String) Configure a scaleout service config template to use
- `user_group_range_end` (Number) User group range end
- `user_group_range_start` (Number) User group range start
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object
